representation.fontProvenance: No font file bundled; host font pixels differ. Fixed world aspect; printable ASCII only.

anchors: Four separated splayed limbs with five rounded toe pads each

parts.name: body
parts.motion: Bounded guided translation and slow turn

parts.name: head
parts.motion: Attached broad head with stable paired eyes

parts.name: limbs
parts.motion: Four jointed limbs; one swing at a time, diagonal order

parts.name: toes
parts.motion: Five pads per foot; fixed world position and fan angle during stance

parts.name: tail
parts.motion: Continuous tapered centerline with smoothly blended curl

phases.name: idle
phases.transition: Guide enters approach; deliberate startle enters response

phases.name: approach
phases.transition: Target reached or leave returns idle; deliberate startle takes priority

phases.name: startle
phases.transition: Hold root and smoothly curl tail, then retreat

phases.name: retreat
phases.transition: Short backward contact-aware steps, then recover

phases.name: recover
phases.transition: Relax curl and cautiously follow target, then cooldown

phases.name: cooldown
phases.transition: Guidance resumes; repeated startle ignored until idle/approach

motion.replayGuarantee: Same version/runtime/seed/options and ordered tick/sequence events produce identical state and ASCII cells regardless of render grouping; no cross-runtime pixel promise.

interaction.pointer: CSS-rect normalization to [-1,1]; coalesce; movement guides only. Empty stage never startles.
interaction.keyboard: Native guide/startle/pause/reset buttons; arrows and Space only with stage focus.
interaction.touch: Tap stage to guide; use native Startle button; scrolling preserved.
interaction.precedence: Atomic batch validation; startle wins behavior priority; busy startles ignored. Rest causes compose. Explicit static poster action under reduced motion.

accessibility.description: A stylized ASCII gecko with a broad head, four splayed pad-toed feet and a long attached tail.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Static poster; deliberate Startle changes to a static curled-tail pose without scheduling.
accessibility.liveRegion: User-action status only; no per-frame announcements.
